title: Anglerfish in Psychedelic Meadow
description: A large black anglerfish with sharp teeth, a glowing lure, and wide eyes floats centrally above a winding yellow path through a vibrant purple flower field. The surreal landscape features two green trees, a cracked earthy foreground with dripping gold and blue textures, and a starry night sky filled with colorful glowing orbs and ornate swirling psychedelic patterns in pink, blue, and purple.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape featuring a large black anglerfish with sharp teeth and a glowing lure floating in the center of the image. The fish hovers above a bright yellow winding path cutting through dense fields of vibrant purple flowers. Two lush green trees frame the scene on either side. The foreground shows cracked earth with dripping layers of gold, teal, and blue paint. The night sky is filled with stars, colorful glowing orbs, and large ornate swirling psychedelic patterns in pink, blue, and purple.
